pwsbuilder July 30, 2017

Meet The Artists Marion Harcourt and Kathy ElKamouny at a free demonstration Saturday, August 5 from 2 to 4 pm at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists

Marion will demonstrate how she paints a dune scene in oil, and Kathy will discuss elements and the challenges of her current work.

The Art Gallery of The Guild of Harwich Artists, 551 Main Street (Route 28), Harwich Port, is open 7-days a week, including extended hours for Summer Port Nights. The Art Gallery exhibits original artwork by 24 local artists. Free public parking located across the street at the Tourist Information Center of the Harwich Chamber of Commerce. Refreshments will be served.
